title: Build impact products
summary: Explore practical digital products around clearly defined environmental or social problems.
detail: The proposed work can combine discovery, interface design, technical prototyping and proportionate testing. Technology is selected only when it offers useful value, with product maturity and limitations stated clearly.
problem: A promising idea may need a focused, testable product response before anyone can responsibly commit to scale.
exclusions: A guaranteed launch, adoption level or impact outcome
Technology chosen solely because it is fashionable
Unreviewed handling of sensitive or production data
process: Understand the need, agree the risk and learning questions, build the smallest useful response, then test and decide what follows.
expectedOutputs: A defined problem and intended user group
A concept or working prototype at an agreed maturity
A decision record covering evidence, risk and next steps
modelNote: Proposed only. Team capacity, eligibility, timing, fees and any subsidised component must be agreed before an engagement is offered.
